pattern: provider retry sent as an unrelated message
experience: After a provider outage, retrying a failed run required reopening the thread and risked sending an unrelated new turn.
rule: Retry the exact failed run with loom_thread_retry_failed_run.
prompt: The provider outage is over. Retry the unchanged failed run 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 in thread 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. Keep it a continuation of that exact run.
